nodes.description: Administrator address of the delegator contract, writable during construction and by _setImplementation.
Pending administrator slot declared in storage but never written in this code.
Active implementation (logic) contract address used for delegatecall in the fallback.
Sets admin to msg.sender, delegates initialization to the implementation, sets implementation and finally assigns admin_.
Admin-only function updating the implementation address after checking msg.sender == admin and non-zero address.
Internal helper performing a low-level delegatecall to an arbitrary callee with arbitrary data.
Payable fallback that delegatecalls the current implementation with the raw msg.data and returns/reverts accordingly.
External caller address, used for admin initialization and for the admin authorization check.
Low-level delegatecall inside delegateTo executed in the context of this contract with caller-supplied callee and data.
Low-level delegatecall inside the fallback forwarding arbitrary msg.data to the implementation, executing untrusted code in this contract's storage context.
Constructor parameter holding the final administrator address assigned at the end of construction.
Constructor parameter encoded into the initialize(address) call delegated to the implementation.
Constructor parameter used as the delegatecall target for initialization and stored as implementation.
New implementation address supplied to _setImplementation and stored into the implementation state variable.
Address targeted by the low-level delegatecall in delegateTo.
Raw calldata bytes forwarded to the low-level delegatecall in delegateTo.
Local copy of the previous implementation address used for the NewImplementation event.
Boolean result of the delegatecall in delegateTo, checked in assembly to decide whether to revert.
Raw return data of the delegatecall in delegateTo, forwarded on revert.
Boolean result of the delegatecall in the fallback, used to choose between revert and return.

edges.reason: msg.sender is written into the admin state variable during construction, making the initial admin the deployer.
_setImplementation authorizes the caller by comparing msg.sender with the stored admin address.
The constructor invokes delegateTo to execute the implementation initialize(address) logic.
The constructor stores the supplied implementation_ value into the implementation state variable via _setImplementation.
The constructor overwrites admin with the admin_ parameter at the end of initialization.
The implementation_ parameter flows into the _setImplementation body as the new implementation value.
_setImplementation reads the current implementation into oldImplementation before overwriting it.
The callee parameter is the target address of the delegated call in delegateTo.
The data parameter provides the calldata payload used by the delegatecall in delegateTo.
The callee parameter is consumed directly by the low-level delegatecall address operand.
The data parameter is consumed directly as the delegatecall calldata payload.
The success flag produced by the delegatecall is checked in the assembly block to conditionally revert.
The delegatecall return data is bubbled up in the revert path of delegateTo.
The fallback reads the implementation state variable to determine its delegatecall target.
The implementation address is the target of the delegatecall executed from the fallback.
The success flag of the fallback delegatecall drives the assembly switch between revert and return.
The delegatecall transfers execution control to an external callee which runs in this contract's storage context and may call back before state changes settle.
The fallback delegatecalls the implementation with arbitrary msg.data, allowing reentrant execution before the call resolves.
The implementation_ constructor parameter is used both as the initialization delegatecall target and as the stored implementation.
The admin_ constructor parameter flows into the admin state variable assignment.
The rewardToken_ constructor parameter is ABI-encoded into the initialize(address) delegatecall.

normalization_plan.reason: The success flag exists only to interpret the outcome of the unsafe delegatecall in delegateTo.
returnData only carries the delegatecall return payload for the revert path.
The fallback success flag exists solely to branch on the result of the unsafe delegatecall.
